mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0') AS clueTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('0','1','2','3')) AS clueProcessing, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '4') AS clueDone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('4','5') AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURDATE()) AS clueOverdue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_person WHERE del_flag = '0') AS personTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_report_record WHERE del_flag = '0') AS reportTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_kb_document WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '已入库') AS kbDocTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_kb_chunk WHERE del_flag = '0') AS kbChunkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_conflict_declare WHERE del_flag = '0') AS conflictTotal

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.status) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_clue_status' AND d.dict_value = c.status WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.status, d.dict_label ORDER BY c.status

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.source_type) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_clue_source' AND d.dict_value = c.source_type WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.source_type, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, c.violation_type) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue c LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_violation_type' AND d.dict_value = c.violation_type WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.violation_type, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_clue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT COALESCE(cat.cat_name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_kb_document d LEFT JOIN jc_kb_category cat ON cat.category_id = d.category_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '已入库' GROUP BY d.category_id, cat.cat_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_report_record WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

done, SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('6','7') AND handle_deadline IS NOT NULL AND handle_deadline < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM jc_petition WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jc_supplier WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('3', '4')

choose.when: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_petition WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_rectify_issue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_reply_request WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

choose.otherwise: SELECT '0' AS month, 0 AS value FROM dual WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: SELECT CASE a.status WHEN '0' THEN '已扣押待入库' WHEN '1' THEN '入库暂存' WHEN '2' THEN '处置中' WHEN '3' THEN '已处置' WHEN '4' THEN '已退还' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_asset_info a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, s.status) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_supplier s LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_supplier_status' AND d.dict_value = s.status WHERE s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY s.status, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(d.dict_label, e.status) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jc_edu_exam e LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'jc_edu_exam_status' AND d.dict_value = e.status WHERE e.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY e.status, d.dict_label ORDER BY value DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT '0' AS name, 0 AS value FROM dual WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: SELECT 'petition' AS moduleKey, '信访举报' AS moduleName, petition_id AS bizId, title AS title, target_dept AS ownerDept, target_name AS ownerName, handle_deadline AS deadline, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), handle_deadline) AS overdueDays FROM jc_petition WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('6','7') AND handle_deadline IS NOT NULL AND handle_deadline < CURDATE()

SELECT 'rectify' AS moduleKey, '整改闭环' AS moduleName, issue_id AS bizId, title AS title, found_dept AS ownerDept, NULL AS ownerName, deadline AS deadline, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), deadline) AS overdueDays FROM jc_rectify_issue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('3','4') AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURDATE()

SELECT 'reply' AS moduleKey, '廉政意见回复' AS moduleName, request_id AS bizId, matter_desc AS title, person_dept AS ownerDept, person_name AS ownerName, DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL deadline_days DAY) AS deadline, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL deadline_days DAY)) AS overdueDays FROM jc_reply_request WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('2','3') AND deadline_days IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL deadline_days DAY) < CURDATE()

SELECT 'conduct' AS moduleKey, '作风建设' AS moduleName, issue_id AS bizId, violation_desc AS title, person_dept AS ownerDept, person_name AS ownerName, check_deadline AS deadline, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), check_deadline) AS overdueDays FROM jc_conduct_issue WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('3','4') AND check_deadline IS NOT NULL AND check_deadline < CURDATE()

SELECT 'asset' AS moduleKey, '涉案财物' AS moduleName, asset_id AS bizId, item_name AS title, person_dept AS ownerDept, person_name AS ownerName, dispose_deadline AS deadline, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), dispose_deadline) AS overdueDays FROM jc_asset_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status NOT IN ('3','4') AND dispose_deadline IS NOT NULL AND dispose_deadline < CURDATE()
